description: Regression gate for the recommended configuration: fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5, hybrid retrieval, ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 reranking of 5 candidates, rerank abstention below -8.4. Calibrated on golden_v2 at hit_rate 0.987 / recall 0.987 / MRR 0.954 overall (0.946 on the test split; with 20 candidates, 1.0 / 1.0 / 0.958 at about 7x the rerank latency), with 8 of 18 unanswerable questions abstained at retrieval and no false abstentions. Run with RAG_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 (downloads two models; free).
